description: Elections Commission - Notify the names of the Members elected for Kandy District in Local Authorities Election - 2018
reasoning: This gazette content contains the official declaration of election results for local authorities, specifically listing the names of elected members for each ward of the Kandy Municipal Council and Wattegama Urban Council. It is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and represents an electoral process matter, fitting the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for election results and declarations.
